mapper.sql: id, team_id, name, avatar, owner_id, announcement, max_members, is_muted_all, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_group (id, team_id, name, avatar, owner_id, announcement, max_members, is_muted_all, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{teamId}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{ownerId}, #{announcement}, #{maxMembers}, #{isMutedAll}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_group SET name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, announcement = #{announcement}, max_members = #{maxMembers}, is_muted_all = #{isMutedAll}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_group WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_group SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
